review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform & DevSecOps)
review_candidates.description: About The Role The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, automates, and maintains high-availability, fault-tolerant, and secure infrastructure powering digital financial products (e.g., nano-finance, consumer finance, e-payments, digital insurance brokerage). Operating within an FRA-regulated environment, this role bridges core software development and the CISO's governance framework. The engineer is responsible for embedding DevSecOps pipelines, automated compliance controls, immutable audit logging, and Disaster Recovery (DR) automation into every layer of the cloud and on-premise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities DevSecOps & CI/CD Automation ▪ Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) ensuring zero-downtime blue/green or canary deployments. ▪ Enforce "shift-left" security controls directly into deployment workflows: integrate automated SAST (Static Application Security Testing), DAST, software composition analysis (SCA), and container image vulnerability scanners (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy). ▪ Enforce binary authorization and artifact signing, ensuring only cryptographically verified images are deployed to production clusters. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Architecture ▪ Architect and manage scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS / Microsoft Azure / local data centers) using Terraform or Terragrunt, maintaining 100% declarative infrastructure. ▪ Ensure infrastructure architecture strictly satisfies Egyptian data residency and hosting regulations as outlined under FRA Decree No. 139/2023 and Decree No. 141/2023 (Fintech Outsourcing Register). ▪ Implement network zoning, Micro-segmentation, Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), and Zero-Trust access rules to isolate microservices, payment gateways, and core non-banking ledger systems. Container Orchestration & Platform Engineering ▪ Manage production-grade Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, or bare metal) focusing on multi-tenancy, resource optimization, autoscaling (HPA/KEDA), and high availability. ▪ Implement Kubernetes security standards: Network Policies, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Pod Security Standards, and runtime threat detection (e.g., Falco). ▪ Provide self-service internal developer platforms (IDPs) that allow product developers to provision test environments and deploy services safely. High Availability, BCM & Disaster Recovery (DR) ▪ Build and automate Disaster Recovery failover protocols to satisfy FRA business continuity thresholds for Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO). ▪ Automate continuous database backups, snapshot replication, and cross-region/cross-zone synchronization. ▪ Lead semi-annual scheduled DR failover drills alongside the CISO and Risk teams, proving operational resilience during simulated complete data center outages. Regulatory Logging, Telemetry & Observability ▪ Deploy enterprise-wide observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog). ▪ Construct tamper-evident, centralized audit log pipelines that stream system, database, and administrative actions directly to the SOC/SIEM, enforcing the FRA's mandatory five-year log retention and immutability rules. ▪ Configure real-time alerts, synthetic monitoring, and SLO/SLI tracking across mission-critical endpoints (digital onboarding, eKYC, and transaction routing). Secrets, Cryptography & eKYC Infrastructure Support ▪ Oversee enterprise secret management using tools like HashiCorp Vault, enforcing short-lived credentials, automated secret rotation, and dynamic database credentials. ▪ Support engineering pipelines that interface with Cloud HSMs and digital signature modules used to seal digital contracts under FRA Decree No. 140 of 2023. Technical Stack ▪ Cloud & Virtualization: AWS, Microsoft Azure, VMware / OpenStack. ▪ Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Helm, Istio / Linkerd. ▪ Infrastructure as Code & Config: Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible. ▪ CI/CD & GitOps: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, FluxCD. ▪ Security & Compliance: HashiCorp Vault, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Wazuh, Falco. ▪ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog. ▪ Scripting & Languages: Python, Bash, Go. Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field. Experience 5–8 years of overall IT/Software Engineering experience, with at least 4 years dedicated to DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Platform Engineering in a FinTech, Digital Banking, or highly regulated transactional environment. Regulatory & Security Understanding Proven track record working under strict InfoSec oversight (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or central bank/financial regulator standards); familiarity with Egypt's data privacy (PDPL 151/2020) and FRA IT requirements. Certifications (Preferred) At least one certified tier: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. Hands-On Depth Strong troubleshooting acumen across Linux kernel internals, TCP/IP networking, DNS, TLS/SSL termination, and distributed systems performance tuning. Core Competencies Security-First Mentality: Considers security and auditability as non-negotiable architectural foundations rather than an afterthought. Automation Advocate: Intolerance for manual, error-prone operational tasks ("toil"); proactive in writing clean automation scripts and IaC modules. Incident Ownership: Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production outages under pressure, conducting blameless post-mortems and driving systemic fixes. Communication: Ability to collaborate seamlessly with software engineers, product managers, quality assurance, and external regulatory auditors.

review_candidates.title: IT Projects & Field Engineer (Level 2–3)
review_candidates.description: About Managed IT Managed IT is a Perth-based managed services and managed security provider. For 21 years we have supported local government, state government, not-for-profit, NDIS, mining and resources, and professional services clients across Western Australia. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, aligned to ITIL 4, and on several WA government supplier panels, so clients trust us with regulated, compliance-heavy environments. In 2026 we were named one of MSP Summit's MSPs to Watch (Informa), the only Western Australian MSP among 130 recognised worldwide. Our service desk must be proactive, not reactive: we find and fix the cause of a fault before clients have to chase us. The role We are looking for a high-calibre business professional who is also an experienced Level 2–3 engineer. This is a projects and field role, not a service desk queue role. Our clients log their support requests through our client portal, and our service desk handles them. Your job is to move our clients forward on site: system upgrades, improvements, desktop standard operating environments (SOEs), device rollouts, the next stage of each client's Microsoft 365 deployment, and reviews that keep each environment aligned to our standards. Some clients have you on site on scheduled days under their agreement with us, because they value white-glove, in-person help. On those days you are the friendly, expert face of Managed IT for their staff: you help people with everyday requests in person, and you make sure every request is logged through our client portal so it is tracked and reported. You will work from a project schedule set by our project management office, at client offices across metro Perth and from our West Perth office. When a support issue needs hands on the hardware, our service desk dispatches the on-site visit to you; the desk keeps ownership of the ticket and the client relationship for that request. You set systems up properly, document them, and hand them over so our service desk can support them from day one. Clients will know you by name, and for many of their staff you will be the only Managed IT person they ever meet. How you present, how you communicate and how well you understand their business matter as much as what you can build. Why business acumen and interpersonal skills matter in this role Our clients are councils, government agencies and professional firms. Every upgrade, rollout and cut-over touches their day: a chief executive's laptop, a finance team in the middle of a payroll run, or a front counter serving the public. The people you work with judge us on how well we understand that. In this role that means: Planning work around the client's business, so changes and cut-overs don't disrupt their day Explaining options in plain business terms (time, cost and risk) and confirming scope, timing and next steps in writing Managing expectations: when something can't be done as planned, the client knows why, what happens next and when Listening carefully, confirming you have understood, and adapting your explanation to the person in front of you, from a new starter to an executive Staying calm, courteous and in control when things go wrong mid-project Exercising complete discretion with the confidential information you see in executive and government offices Noticing where technology is holding a client back, and bringing it to our account team with the evidence so we can help them improve Doing what you said you would do, when you said you would do it What you will do Deliver client projects on site: system upgrades, server and network replacements, office set-ups and office moves Build and maintain desktop SOEs with Intune and Autopilot, and run device rollouts and refreshes from plan to handover Advance each client's Microsoft 365 deployment to our standards: device enrolment and compliance, migrations, and rollout of Microsoft 365 capability the client has approved Deliver the improvements clients agree to in their business reviews with us Plan every change, record evidence before you start, and make configuration changes only through our approved change process, with a tested back-out plan Document every build as-built in IT Glue and hand it over formally to the service desk Write and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), and map processes as clear flow diagrams that the service desk and clients can follow Map client networks on site and keep each site's network diagram current, so every environment is documented as it really is Carry out technical alignment reviews: check each client's environment against our standards, record the gaps, and recommend the improvements for their next business review Assist with asset lifecycle management on site: recording and tagging devices, deploying replacements, and collecting retired equipment for secure disposal, so asset records match what is actually on site Provide white-glove, in-person user support on scheduled on-site days at clients whose agreements include it, logging every request through our client portal or service desk Attend on-site support visits and in-person new-starter set-ups when the service desk dispatches them to you Record your time and progress accurately in Autotask against each project and visit Keep the project manager, service desk leadership and the client informed of progress, risks and anything that could affect the client's satisfaction What success looks like Projects delivered on time and on budget, changes that work the first time, builds, SOPs and network diagrams the service desk can use from day one, asset records that match what is on site, alignment gaps closed, and clients who ask for you by name. About you A high-calibre professional with polished written and spoken communication, and the confidence to work with executives and senior managers Strong business acumen: you understand how organisations run and how technology affects their work, costs and risk At least 5 years in IT, including at least 2 years at Level 2–3 with a managed service provider (MSP) or other multi-client employer Proven hands-on project delivery, not only support: you have upgraded and replaced servers and networks, built and rolled out SOEs with Intune and Autopilot, and moved clients forward on Microsoft 365 A complete modern workplace skill set, which we treat as a given: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, Intune and Autopilot, Windows 11 and endpoint security Practical infrastructure skills: Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy; switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi and firewalls Experience with MSP tools such as Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue, or similar Current Microsoft certification (for example MD-102, MS-102 or AZ-104), with a commitment to keep building. Fortinet experience, ITIL 4 Foundation and experience with Citrix or virtual desktops are an advantage Comfortable using AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude day to day, with the judgement to check their output and protect client data Strong documentation skills: as-built records, network diagrams, SOPs and process flow maps that others can follow, because our team supports what you build Experience reviewing environments against a standard or framework, such as a standards checklist, the Essential Eight or CIS Controls, is an advantage A genuine service mindset: you enjoy helping people in person and make a non-technical user feel looked after Calm, reliable and organised across several projects at once Presentation and dress standard This is a business professional role. On client sites and in our office you will wear business professional attire, such as a collared shirt or blouse with tailored trousers or a skirt, and clean, enclosed shoes. Hoodies, t-shirts, activewear and casual wear are not part of our dress standard. Working arrangements Full time, Monday to Friday business hours, with occasional planned after-hours work for cut-overs and upgrades. This is a fully on-site role, split between client sites across metro Perth and our West Perth office. It is not a hybrid or work-from-home role. A current Australian driver's licence and a reliable vehicle are essential for travel between sites. A vehicle allowance is paid in line with the Business Equipment Award. Right to work in Australia, and a National Police Check before you start and every year after. A criminal record will not automatically exclude you; it is assessed against the requirements of the role. What we offer $85,000 to $95,000 plus superannuation, depending on experience A vehicle allowance, company laptop and mobile phone Ongoing Microsoft and ITIL certification A modern West Perth office with nearby parking, shops and public transport An established, ISO 27001 certified MSP where every role has clear weekly measures and the support to meet them How we hire A short screening call, a technical interview, and a practical exercise in two parts. First, plan a small upgrade or device rollout for a client and talk us through your change plan, back-out and how you would keep the client informed. Second, write the as-built note and a short SOP for the service desk. Shortlisted candidates then have a structured meeting with a client representative, assessed against set criteria for client communication, followed by reference and police checks.
